caveats: The Russian and Uzbek names of all administrative units are official. The English names of administrative levels 0 and 1 are official translations whereas the administrative level 2 English names are unofficial translations.
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other: These administrative boundaries of Uzbekistan are not official datasets. They were downloaded from an open source and OCHA integrated COATO codes (a national P-coding system), feature names and types in the English, Russian, and Uzbek languages. The COATO codes are as of 8 November 2017.  Three cities (Shahrisabz city UZ10405, Khiva city UZ33406, and Nurafshon city UZ27401) that were missing from the administrative level  2 source were added from [Open Street Map](https://www.openstreetmap.org).
name: cod-ab-uzb
notes:
Uzbekistan administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset.

The date that these administrative boundaries were established is unknown.

NOTE:  See COD-PS caveats about sex and age disaggregation and feature name translations.  COD-PS to be updated shortly.

This COD-AB was most recently reviewed for accuracy and necessary changes in January 2024.  The COD-AB does not require any update.

Sourced from OCHA

Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID.

This COD-AB is suitable for database or GIS linkage to the Uzbekistan [COD-PS](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-uzb).

No edge-matched (COD-EM) version of this COD-AB has yet been prepared.

Please see the [COD Portal](https://cod.unocha.org/).

Administrative level 1 contains 14 feature(s).  The normal administrative level 1 feature type is ""currently not known"".

Administrative level 2 contains 199 feature(s).  The normal administrative level 2 feature type is ""currently not known"".

Recommended cartographic projection:  Asia South Albers Equal Area Conic

This metadata was last updated on January 13, 2025.
